params.description: if **true** Owner array will populate the nextAssessment array, else, **false** and nextAssessment array will display as null

params.description: if **true**, Owner array will populate the bkList array, else, **false** and bkList field will display as null

params.name: includeBalanceByChargeType
params.description: if **true**, Owner array will populate the balanceByChargeType, else, **false** and balanceByChargeType will display as null.

params.name: includePropertyCount
params.description: if **true**, response will include propertyCount field, else, **false** and propertyCount field will display as null

params.name: includeStartingMonthOfFiscalYear
params.description: if **true**, response will include startingMonthOfFiscalYear field, else, **false** and startingMonthOfFiscalYear field will display as null.

params.name: includeAssessmentFrequency
params.description: if **true**, response will include assessmentFrequencies array, else, **false** and assessmentFrequencies array will display as null
